header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2022 and was lastly fixed in the court on 28.09.2022, but thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.

The perusal of prayer clause reflects that this petition was filed to suspend the operation of office order dated 01.04.2022 issued by the respondent No.5, with further prayer to direct respondent No.8 to constitute a JIT to conduct thorough inquiry into the matter.

From the perusal of prayer clause, it reveals that interim relief has been sought through the instant petition and no any substantive relief of the order dated 01.04.2022 has been sought. Therefore, this petition, being not maintainable, is hereby dismissed. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
